notes.title: A new update is available NOW + Steam Summer Sale!
notes.notes:
[b]A new update is available now for [i]Homestead Arcana[/i]![/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented the player from healing blighted plants
[*] Fixed the "You Take My Breath Away" achievement (escape miasma without any breath meter) falsely triggering upon respawn when dying in miasma
[*] Fixed mail bugs that resulted in broken letters
[*] Fixed asset pop-in while traveling through restored areas
[*] Changed recipes to ignore stack requirements, allowing the player to buy and pick up recipes in the world that they had already learned from other means, preventing an apparent "inventory full" bug
[*] Removed the Persevering Token item from the Swamp 
[*] Fixed Green Ankle Boots being unable to be crafted
[*] Updated the intro credits sequence
[*] Allowed the intro video to scale appropriately to screen size
[/list]

[b][i]Homestead Arcana[/i] is 20% off during the Steam Summer Sale![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1867520/Homestead_Arcana/

notes.title: Welcome to the magical frontier! Homestead Arcana is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
You're here! 
We're so glad you finally made it, we have a lot of work to do, here on the range. Now that [i]Homestead Arcana[/i] [b]is finally out[/b], you can finally start your great adventure! 

[previewyoutube=rL3MNzUVb4c;full][/previewyoutube]

With all this Miasma covering the land, you will have to establish your own homestead and power up your magic with nature before venturing out. Saving the world is no easy task, you know, but as a trained witch you surely are up to it! 

After you set up your first outpost, and plant first seedlings into the ground, head on to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1867520/discussions/]our Steam forum[/url] to share your adventures in the world of [i]Homestead Arcana[/i]!  

Welcome to the magical frontier!

notes.title: Homestead Arcana has a release date and a brand new trailer!
notes.notes:
As you know, in Homestead Arcana you become a farming Witch and pioneer the range that has been mysteriously corrupted with deathly Miasma. 

But what does it all mean? 

Here comes your trusted familiar Huckleberry (voiced by Yuri Lowenthal) to explain: 

[previewyoutube=T66FUUZ7Wu0;full][/previewyoutube]


As you have probably also noticed, we have announced the release date: APRIL 21st! 

Get ready to plant, harvest, craft, cook, and upgrade your gear before you venture out to explore the Miasma and discover its secrets!

notes.title: Feel the magic of Homestead Arcana in a brand new trailer!
notes.notes:
Life here on the Range would be quiet and peaceful if not for all that choking Miasma surrounding our homestead. 

We are excited to show you our brand new trailer, featured in the recent IGN Fan Fest, voiced by Yuri Lowenthal (the start of many games, including Homestead Arcana)... erm, we mean your trusty familiar Huckleberry... 

Enjoy the new trailer and see you on the Range!

You can catch the [url=https://www.ign.com/articles/how-to-watch-ign-fan-fest-2023-on-steam]restream[/url] Saturday, February 17 at 10 am PT

notes.title: Homestead Arcana Wins Official Selection in Game Maker's 2022 Sketchbook
notes.notes:
[img]https://www.gamemakerssketchbook.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/22_GMS_award_laurel-w-768x768.png[/img]

The Academy of Interactive Arts & Sciences unveiled their official selections for the 2022 Game Maker's Sketchbook and Homestead Arcana's key art was selected as a winner in the Impact category. 

To read the full list of winners go [url=https://www.gamemakerssketchbook.com/2022-winners/]here[/url]

Become a farming Witch and pioneer the range that has been mysteriously corrupted with Miasma. Discover the secret behind its appearance, grow plants to power up your spells, and use nature’s magic to heal the land.
